label: Emotional Pop Ballad
blueprintGuidance: Lead with a strong emotional chorus idea.
Center the arrangement around piano and warm harmonic support.
generationGuidance: Build toward a singable chorus with a clear emotional lift.
Use soft drums, warm bass, airy pads, and gentle textures.
For short-form tracks, keep the chorus immediately recognizable.
avoidGuidance: Avoid aggressive drums or overly dense synth stacks.
Avoid long instrumental detours before the chorus.
